author: Jerseys
body:
• My username is Rowth
  • I have banned for hacking on my alt called SmoshWars
  • I have changed dramatically! I have not alted once!  
  • I should be unbanned because I haven't alted for over 30 days/month. I have not even alted once from that day. I have changed my attitude and wont commit a crime again. Everyone deserves a second chance, even the hated ones.  I hacked because I thought my Minecraft days were over but i shouldn't hack on the server I love. I'v learnt my lesson, and I will never ever do it again. I'm sorry... 
I do regret have I have done,
